meta.how: subagent 讀 SKILL.md、用 ai_api.py 查

answers.outline-stroke-cmd: app.executeMenuCommand('OffsetPath v22') — Object > Path > Outline Stroke (verified ✅). (Not 'Live Outline Stroke', which is the Effect > Path > Outline Stroke live effect.)
answers.offset-path-cmd: app.executeMenuCommand('OffsetPath v23') — Object > Path > Offset Path (opens the Offset Path dialog; the offset is typed via a dialog plan). Scripted alternative: AI.offsetPath(item, d) + AI.expandAppearance(). ('Live Offset Path' is the Effect version.)
answers.livepaint-make-cmd: app.executeMenuCommand('Make Planet X') — Object > Live Paint > Make (verified ✅).
answers.split-grid-cmd: app.executeMenuCommand('Rows and Columns....') — Object > Path > Split Into Grid (opens a dialog; rows/columns were set through UI Automation in the sweep; the dialog remembers last-used values, so set the fields).
answers.lock-above-cmd: app.executeMenuCommand('Selection Hat 5') — Object > Lock > All Artwork Above (DOM equivalent: item.locked = true for items with absoluteZOrderPosition above the selection). ('Selection Hat 4' is Hide > All Artwork Above.)
answers.rasterize-cmd: app.executeMenuCommand('Rasterize 8 menu item') — Object > Rasterize. DOM equivalent: document.rasterize(item, bounds, RasterizeOptions) / AI.rasterize(). ('Live Rasterize' is Effect > Rasterize.)
answers.feather-effect-name: LiveEffect name 'Adobe Fuzzy Mask'; radius key 'Radius' (real). Default XML: <LiveEffect name="Adobe Fuzzy Mask"><Dict data="R Radius 5.0 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.pucker-effect-name: LiveEffect name 'Adobe Punk and Bloat'; amount key 'd_factor' (real). Default XML: <LiveEffect name="Adobe Punk and Bloat"><Dict data="R d_factor 0.0 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.gaussian-effect-name: LiveEffect name 'Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur'; radius key 'blur' (real). Default XML: <LiveEffect name="Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur"><Dict data="I PrevDres 72 R blur 10.0 R PrevDocScale 1.0 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.zigzag-effect-keys: LiveEffect name 'Adobe Zigzag'; ridges per segment key 'ridges' (real, default 4.0). Other keys: amount, absoluteness, roundness, relAmount. Default: <LiveEffect name="Adobe Zigzag"><Dict data="R amount 10.0 R ridges 4.0 R absoluteness 1.0 R roundness 0.0 R relAmount 10.0 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.dropshadow-offset-keys: X offset = 'horz', Y offset = 'vert', opacity = 'opac' (0-1, default 0.75). Default XML: <LiveEffect name="Adobe Drop Shadow"><Dict data="B usePSLBlur 1 R dark 100.0 I blnd 1 R blur 5.0 B pair 1 R vert 7.0 R horz 7.0 I csrc 0 R opac 0.75 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.blocked-menu-cmds: The two blocked commands: (1) File > Save Selected Slices ('Adobe AI Save Selected Slices') — the legacy Save for Web 'Save Optimized As' file dialog re-opens itself after every answer (loops); use Export for Screens (AI.exportScreens) or AI.png/AI.jpg instead. (2) File > Print ('Print') — document.print() to Adobe PostScript File never returns (timed out after 180 s, job goes to the OS spooler); use AI.pdf()/AI.png() instead.
answers.repeat-config-null: In 28.0 the getters radialConfig / gridConfig / symmetryConfig on a Repeat item return/throw a "NULL pointer" error, so they cannot be read or used. The skill sets Repeat options through the menu Object > Repeat > Options with a dialog plan (run_js(code, dialog=[...]) typing into the dialog) instead.
answers.press-quality-bleed: A PDF preset such as '[Press Quality]' resets the document bleed to 0 in the saved PDF. To keep the bleed: leave pDFPreset unset and set pDFXStandard = PDFXStandard.PDFX1A2001 plus trimMarks = true (bleed kept, verified via the PDF's BleedBox). The document bleed itself is set with DocumentPreset.documentBleedOffset.
answers.graphitem-unverified: GraphItem.opacity is 'unverified' (marked '?': in the type library only, not verified at runtime — verified=false, not COM-only; GraphItem could not be created in the sandbox).
